audit_A_preregistered_compliance.purpose: Execute a gate already frozen in the original R4A preregistration but not explicitly enforced by the final mechanical runner.
audit_A_preregistered_compliance.rule: No new threshold. Measure the frozen Treatment against the frozen shared Sequence/Scene plan-purpose text using deterministic exact and normalized-copy detection. Any direct serialized plan-purpose copy that meets the frozen definition constitutes failure.
audit_A_preregistered_compliance.on_pass: R4A remains eligible for G6 masking.
audit_A_preregistered_compliance.on_fail: R4A becomes PRESCORE_HOLD_INVALID_FOR_SCORING. No prose repair, no third attempt, no masking, no judge scoring. Start a new fresh experiment only.

audit_B_common_mode_diagnostics.purpose: Measure Claude-identified absolute surface contamination on frozen R4A arms without adding post-output PASS/FAIL gates.
audit_B_common_mode_diagnostics.historical_regression_control: The same diagnostic implementation must reproduce the known I4K-4 contamination signature before its R4A numbers are trusted.

next_legal_action: Implement and run Audit A and Audit B on the already frozen exact-arm manifests. Do not create the mask until Audit A passes.
